title: Red Sangria
origin: Migrated from Recipes - Seis de Mayo.docx (Seis de Mayo party, 2018)

items: ½ apple, cored, skin on, chopped small
½ orange, rind on, chopped small, seeds removed (plus slices for garnish)
3 to 4 Tbsp brown sugar (41 to 55 g) (or 3 Tbsp cane sugar)
¾ cup orange juice (180 ml), plus more to taste
⅓ cup brandy (80 ml), plus more to taste
1 bottle (750 ml) dry Spanish red wine

steps.action: Chill; serve over ice with orange slices.

edits: The 2018 note listed ingredients only; method summarized from the source during archiving
